description.value:
Trigger A non-hryngar creature drinks from the fountain

Effect The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save with the following effects; the drinker is then temporarily immune to the water's Tainted Taste for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is healed @Damage[4d8[healing]] Hit Points, and any wounded condition it has is removed.

Success The target regains @Damage[2d8[healing]] Hit Points, and its wounded condition is removed.

Failure The target regains @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points and gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} condition.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 1} condition.

stealth.details: (trained) to realize the water is dangerous; spotting the fountain is DC 0

details.description: Water pours from this carved dwarf's mouth and has a sharp, rusty flavor.
details.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:16] (trained) to plug up the mouth and cause the fountain to deactivate as long as it remains plugged, @Check[religion|dc:21] (expert) to pray to gods opposed to Droskar to exorcise the magic and permanently halt the water flow, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dispel Magic] (2nd rank; counteract DC 16) to suppress the trap's tainted taste effect for 10 minutes
